identities.notes: Any device exposing the standard LampArray collection 0059:0001: keyboards, mice and accessories that support Windows Dynamic Lighting. The name shown is the device's own.

references.title: USB HID Usage Tables 1.4 (Lighting And Illumination page)

use.purpose: HID LampArray: attribute, lamp, range-update and control feature reports; IDs and layout read from the descriptor

windows.notes: Windows Dynamic Lighting and vendor apps drive the same reports

linux.notes: Needs a udev rule for hidraw

limitations: A standard: report layout comes from the device's descriptor, so any LampArray device works the same way.
Colours and autonomous mode cannot be read back; UDB reports them as sent, never confirmed.
Host-set colours are volatile; devices start in autonomous mode.
Per-key colours (multi-lamp updates) are not implemented.

evidence.source: HID Usage Tables 1.4, page 0x59; Microsoft ArduinoHidForWindows reference device @deb7e5e2: LampArrayAttributesReport (02) and LampAttributesResponseReport (22) via GET_FEATURE
